narrative.overview: ARZ feels like a tailor's workshop on a quiet afternoon: unbleached cloth on the table, deep walnut thread, a glint of zari. The page is warm muslin, never stark white. Garment photography does the talking, framed edge to edge, and the interface stays out of its way. Type is a classical serif throughout, so even prices and labels read as considered rather than transactional. The mood is warm, refined and minimal. Space is generous, elements are few, and ornament comes from the clothes themselves, not the UI. Interactive pieces are soft and tactile: pill-shaped calls to action, gentle lifts and image swaps on hover, never sharp jolts.
keyCharacteristics: Warm muslin background (never pure white) with walnut-brown and ink text.
Classical serif everywhere; uppercase, wide-tracked labels for navigation and small captions.
Full-bleed, square-cornered product imagery; soft pill CTAs.
Gold appears as an accent detail, not a fill.
Calm motion: short fades and small lifts, respecting reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Muslin Ground Rule
rules.body: The page background is always Unbleached Muslin. White surfaces read as a different, colder brand.

rules.name: The Zari Thread Rule
rules.body: Gold is a thread, not a fabric: use it for lines, small marks and highlights, never as a background block or a large button.

rules.name: The Single Family Voice Rule
rules.body: Everything is serif. No sans-serif UI text, including buttons and forms.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; shadows only answer to interaction or scroll state.

rules.name: The Square Frame Rule
rules.body: Garment imagery is never rounded; rounding is reserved for controls.

dos: Do keep every page on Unbleached Muslin, with Walnut Thread and Ink for text.
Do let photography run full-bleed with square corners.
Do use uppercase, wide-tracked serif for navigation, labels and CTAs.
Do keep motion short (≈0.3–0.7s, ease-out), small (≤18px travel), and off under reduced motion.
Do scope section CSS to its own section wrapper. Shopify loads every section's styles on every page.
donts: Don't use white page backgrounds or cold greys as surfaces.
Don't use gold as a fill or for large buttons.
Don't round garment images or put them in floating rounded frames.
Don't borrow Corso Velle's visual identity; ARZ stays distinct.
